name.value: The Inn at the Union Club

description.value: The Inn at the Union Club is the guest accommodation wing of the Union Club of British Columbia, a heritage private members' club founded in 1879 and situated in the heart of downtown Victoria near the inner harbour. The inn offers 22 guest rooms and suites and is open to Union Club members and their guests, as well as members of more than 400 affiliated clubs worldwide. Guests receive access to the club's Executive Fitness Centre, billiards room, rooftop terrace, and dining facilities as part of their stay.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (2 spaces) at 49m; rack (12 spaces) at 90m; rack at 98m; rack at 98m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is active (copyright 2026), confirming this is a real operating accommodation at 805 Gordon Street, Victoria. The website consistently shows (250) 384-1151 as the contact number, which differs from the OSM-listed 800 number; the website value is used as primary. Wi-Fi is confirmed ('Wireless internet access...included') matching OSM's internet_access=wlan tag, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-800-808-2218 but the website consistently shows (250) 384-1151 as the primary contact number. The website number has been used.

Access is restricted: accommodation is available only to Union Club members, their guests, or members of 400+ affiliated clubs — not freely open to the general public. May not suit all touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in downtown Victoria with an active website and confirmed address. Access is restricted to members and affiliated club members but the club network spans 400+ clubs, making it a plausible stay for touring cyclists who are members.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM address field lacked postal code and city; the website footer provided the full address '805 Gordon Street, Victoria, BC V8W 1Z6' (noting a typo 'Gordon Steet' in the footer, clearly a transcription error). Offsite parking only — the club's private lot is members-only.
